name: @cardo/cardo-desktop
description: Cardo desktop shell: supervises a bundled DeepSeek Harness (dsh) runtime and hosts its Web UI in an Electron window. Self-contained — owns its own DSH_HOME under the app's user-data dir, never touches ~/.dsh.

scripts.package: pnpm run prepare && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
